name: player_record_node_flags_for_restore
description: Player::RecordNodeFlagsForRestore appends a node and its current cell-pickable, raycastable, and pickable flags to the restore vector.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this authored body; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent Player ZAR/contact source-cluster pass.
The smoke verifies the natural std::vector<PlayerNodeFlagRestoreEntry> interface and does not treat compiler-generated _Ucopy/_Ufill factoring as authored behavior.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x41ecd0 validates the node flag getter calls, the 16-byte PlayerNodeFlagRestoreEntry payload, append-at-end vector insertion, capacity growth from 0 to 1, from 1 to 2, and doubling when size is greater than 1.

The native smoke saves and restores the natural vector object through swap, starts from an empty vector, records three nodes with distinct flag combinations, and verifies values, size, and capacity through std::vector public operations.
